ranks: Reality Fracture (FRA)'s last 14, Reality Fracture Commander (FRC) and The Hobbit (HOB): each set's top 50% by EDHREC rank (the next 60 of the set walk); with storied built this batch (rule 702.195) and The Hobbit's storied cards outside the threshold

authored.name: Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills
An Unexpected Party // At the Door

blocked.name: Gideon the Oathless
blocked.why: "Whenever an opponent activates a loyalty ability": the activates-ability trigger exists only for who: "attached" (Illusionist's Bracers).

blocked.name: Elrond, Moon-Reader
blocked.why: "Whenever you activate an ability of a creature" (mana abilities included, per its ruling): no activates-ability trigger beyond who: "attached", and that one never sees a mana ability.

blocked.name: Glamdring, Foe-hammer // Gleam of Death
blocked.why: "Cost {X} less, where X is equipped creature's power": CostReductionAmount can't read the host of the Equipment doing the reducing.

blocked.name: Bilbo, Thief in the Night
blocked.why: "Spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {1} less": a costModification filter can't read the zone a spell is being cast from (castFrom is set only once it's on the stack).

blocked.name: Dáin Ironfoot
blocked.why: "Create … Axe … When you do, attach it to target creature you control": a reflexive trigger's effect can't refer to the token the creating resolution made (attach's "created" is only a host, in the same resolution).

blocked.name: Thorin, Mountain-king
blocked.why: "When one or more Equipment become attached to that creature this way, that creature deals damage …": the reflexive ability can't name the creating ability's target creature, nor gate on how many attached this way.

blocked.name: Sting, Bilbo's Sword
blocked.why: Hone counters (each grants +1/+0 to the creature the Equipment is attached to, from the counter itself) aren't modeled anywhere in the engine.

blocked.name: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty
blocked.why: prohibits.abilitiesOf covers only permanents' abilities, mana abilities included (not 'abilities that aren't mana abilities' from any zone); attacks-alone can't require that the lone attacker attacks a player

blocked.name: Jace, Multiverse Architect
blocked.why: no 'that opponent may pay {2}; if they don't, their creatures can't attack Jaces you control this turn' effect (the loyalty abilities are expressible: Aminatou/Identity Echo shapes)

blocked.name: Kíli the Resourceful
blocked.why: storied / enduring story isn't built; nor 'pay {0} rather than the equip cost of the first equip ability you activate each turn'

blocked.name: Bard, King of Dale
blocked.why: drawCountFor ignores exceptFirstInDrawStep for a 'draw two instead', and takes the max of draw-N replacements where two Bards multiply (ruling: x4)

blocked.name: Desert Were-Worm
blocked.why: attack-with counts attackers; no 'attack with creatures with total power 12 or greater for the first time each turn' trigger

blocked.name: The Eagles Are Coming!
blocked.why: the next-upkeep delayed trigger can't count the creatures returned this way: thisWay doesn't carry into it, and about-targets drop a returned token (the ruling counts tokens)

blocked.name: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight
blocked.why: 'Whenever you scry or surveil': a surveils trigger exists, a scry one doesn't.

blocked.name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
blocked.why: 'When you discard this card, you gain 3 life': a discards trigger can't fire from the card itself as it reaches the graveyard (the graveyard scan skips a card that arrived in the same event).

blocked.name: The Master of Lake-town
blocked.why: 'Draw a card for each graveyard with seven or more cards in it': no amount counts players whose graveyard holds N or more cards (cards-in-graveyard is your own only).

blocked.name: Beorn's Hospitality
blocked.why: Becomes a Bear creature that gains 'P/T each equal to the number of lands you control': animate reads its P/T once, never live.

blocked.name: Dwalin, Weaponmaster
blocked.why: Hone counters (rule 122.1j: +1/+0 to the creature the Equipment is attached to) aren't modeled.
